gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads crisp and current, its curves stopping well short of closing up. Wallpoet is the one built to make a loud entrance, while Noto Sans Adlam does the quiet work of keeping text open and legible.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoi: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined looks tidy and modern, with gaps where curves meet stems. Over a long stretch it keeps a smooth, steady pace, since upper and lower case sit so close in height that nothing jolts the eye.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-h: Wallpoet's letters look stenciled, with paper showing through every line. What makes the pair work is how that cut-up, commanding display face leans against a body whose tall lowercase and outward-pointing tips stay plain and open.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Noto Sans Arabic brings wide openings on its small letters and a pronounced x-height, a tidy modern base for the text. Wallpoet earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Wallpoet is all stencil-cut swagger and tall lowercase. Noto Sans Armenian does the opposite job, offering wide, inviting round letters that make steady text feel approachable while the heading handles the shouting.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Wallpoet hits hard, its lines split by thin slivers of paper and its curves running smooth. Noto Sans Avestan takes the other job, with tall lowercase and curve tips that never touch, so text stays clear and open.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Cut-stencil boldness up top, then lowercase with breathing room inside every curve and ascenders that stay short. Wallpoet commands attention while Noto Sans Balinese quietly holds the text.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum is clean and modern, with big open counters in every small letter. Under a heading as loud as Wallpoet, Noto Sans Bamum could go a touch smaller and still read comfortably.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Wallpoet is bold stencil lettering, smooth around every bend with paper showing between its cuts. Noto Sans Bassa Vah counters with a huge midsection and open-jawed c shapes, giving the pair a loud-meets-sturdy streak.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-sans-batak: Wallpoet comes in bold and stencil-cut. Noto Sans Batak sits underneath with a towering x-height and an e that never looks squeezed, so the loud heading and the friendly text divide the work cleanly.
